admitted_condition.balance: each component after separator removal has at most 2n/3 variables
admitted_condition.discovery: deterministic enumeration of separators up to k; OPEN if none

audit.alignment: The output is a proof-carrying macro representation of a deterministic structured decomposable circuit respecting one fixed vtree.
audit.claim_boundary: Fixed-k structured compilation only. The procedure returns OPEN when no allowed balanced separator is found or when the explicit circuit budget is exceeded. It does not show that arbitrary CNF has bounded k, does not optimize vtrees globally, and does not resolve P versus NP.
audit.theorem: For every fixed separator bound k, the assignment-independent recursive separator plan and its structured deterministic compilation are constructible and independently replayable in n^{O(k)} total work on admitted formulas.

claim_boundary: Exact fixed-k recursive-separator compiler only; no universal CNF algorithm and no resolution of P versus NP.
decisive_limitation: Small primal separators are not necessary for tractability: the dense dual-Horn control is solved by the C033 portfolio but returns OPEN here.
forbidden_promotions: treating k as input while hiding n^O(k) in a polynomial claim
treating a supplied vtree or tree decomposition as free discovery
choosing a different vtree after each separator assignment
inferring polynomial construction from a small final representation
using an exponential lower bound for one structured language as P!=NP
promoting finite audits to universal correctness
guarantees: one verified vtree for all branches
exact SAT decision on admitted formulas
